title: Brenton English Septuagint, Ruth — local browser-visible text captures
edition: Sir Lancelot Charles Lee Brenton, The Septuagint Version of the Old Testament (1851)
capture_method: Text copied from the visible page text returned for each official eBible.org chapter URL. These UTF-8 files preserve the page labels and wording as returned, but are not byte-for-byte HTTP bodies or raw HTML.
limitations: The captures and parser support chapter/order/label checks. They do not prove exact identity with Brenton’s printed 1851 edition, textual completeness, translation accuracy against Greek, or alignment with the separate Geʽez witness. eBible.org identifies the 1851 translation as public domain; page presentation is not claimed as public domain.
